meta.title: Enterprise Security & Alerting for Elasticsearch | Search Guard
meta.description: Search Guard makes Elasticsearch enterprise-ready: security, alerting, encryption at rest and index management. One plugin, one flat license per cluster, unlimited nodes.

hero.headline: Everything Elasticsearch needs to be enterprise-ready
hero.text: Security, alerting, encryption at rest, and index management — one plugin, one flat license per cluster, unlimited nodes. Built and supported in Germany since 2013.

card1.headline: Security beyond the basics
card1.text: Elasticsearch ships with essential security built in. Search Guard adds what enterprises actually run on: SAML, OpenID Connect, LDAP and Active Directory, document- and field-level security, Kibana multi-tenancy, and audit logging that satisfies your compliance team.

card2.headline: One flat license per cluster
card2.text: Licensed per production cluster — never per node. Scale from 3 nodes to 300 without your costs moving an inch. Development, staging, and QA systems are always free.

card3.headline: One plugin instead of five tools
card3.text: Alerting, encryption at rest, index lifecycle management, and anomaly detection ship in the same plugin as security. One download, one upgrade path, one support contact — no integration project.

card4.headline: Support by the people who build it
card4.text: Your ticket is answered by the engineers who wrote the code — with SLAs, directly from Berlin. Developed, hosted, and supported entirely in Germany.

pillars.headline: One plugin. The complete toolkit.
pillars.intro: Search Guard grew from securing Elasticsearch into everything around it — alerting, encryption, and index operations included.
pillars.previewNote: Preview features are included in every trial — try them and tell us what you think.

security.headline: Security
security.text: Authentication, role-based access control down to fields and documents, multi-tenancy, and full audit logging.

alerting.headline: Alerting
alerting.text: Watch your data around the clock. Escalate through email, Slack, PagerDuty, Jira, and webhooks — free in every edition.

encryption.headline: Encryption at Rest
encryption.text: Encrypt indices at the Lucene level. Keys stay in memory, never on disk — ready for the EU Cyber Resilience Act.

indexManagement.headline: Index Management
indexManagement.text: Automate rollover, retention, and deletion policies. Keep clusters lean without cron-job archaeology.

anomalyDetection.headline: Anomaly Detection
anomalyDetection.text: AI-assisted detection of unusual patterns in your data — find what rule-based alerting can't.
